questions.prompt: Choose the correct missing words in this sentence. When solids, liquids and gases are heated they expand and take up more space. The ________ of the object increases and the __________ of the object decreases.
questions.explanation: B:volume increases and density decreases for ordinary thermal expansion at constant mass;there are material/temperature exceptions.

questions.prompt: Rusting is a chemical reaction therefore:
options: a new substance has been made.
It can only be an endothermic reaction.
it can only be a Non-spontaneous reaction.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct missing words in this sentence. When solids, liquids or gases are cooled, they contract and take up less space. The volume of the object _________ and the density of the object __________.
questions.explanation: B:volume decreases,density increases for ordinary cooling at fixed mass;not universal for all materials/temperatures.

options: Its particles are spread evenly through the air.
Its particles are spread unevenly through the air.
Its particles are spread evenly through a solid.
Its particles are spread unevenly through the solid.
questions.explanation: A:diffusion spreads particles through available space toward a more uniform distribution.

questions.prompt: Perfume is sprayed at one end of the classroom and shortly after students at the other end of  the room could smell the perfume. This is because a process occurred called:

options: A change that results in reactants being produced.
A change that results in a new substance being formed.
A change that does not result in a new substance being formed.
A change that does not result in reactants being produced.
